steps.text: Hello, little chefs! I'm Chef Maya. Let's build a crunchy, colourful vegetable sandwich!
Wash your hands and crunchy veggies thoroughly. Ask a grown-up to help slice the vegetables.
We have soft bread slices, fresh cucumber, juicy red tomato, and tangy mint spread.
Place two slices of soft fresh bread neatly onto our clean cutting board.
Smooth a thin layer of bright green spread right across the bread.
Layer cool sliced cucumber and juicy red tomato slices on top.
Place the second slice of bread on top and press down gently to complete our sandwich.
Transfer the healthy vegetable sandwich onto our serving plate. Fantastic job!
